title: Queen Mom Rules
synopsis: At her parents' anniversary party, a successful CEO is dismissed as a low-class nobody, her diamond gift is called fake, and she's even banned from the table!

title: Ultimate Food Deliveryman
synopsis: He was once the revered master of the Sky Medical Palace, respected by all. Obeying the orders of his master, he pretended to be a food deliveryman and married into the Lewis family for a year. In this duration, he plowed through countless side eyes and now... His one year duration is up—it is time to turn the tables around!

title: I Left On My Wedding Day: My Revenge Begins
original_title: I Left On My Wedding Day: My Revenge Begins
synopsis: On her wedding day, Claire discovers her fiancé and best friend have turned her blind father into a cruel bet. She walks out, takes her father to Munich for surgery, and builds a new life. But when her ex-fiancé comes chasing after her, will her newfound freedom be enough to keep him out forever?

title: My Boyfriend’s Brother Calls Me Baby
original_title: My Boyfriend’s Brother Calls Me Baby
synopsis: Blinded in a crash caused by her selfish boyfriend Dominic, Lila is left in the care of his older brother Hubert, a powerful mafia don who pretends to be Dominic. As her sight slowly returns partially, Lila uncovers the cruel fraud. Moved by Hubert's sincere devotion, she publicly chooses him over Dominic. The pair must face family opposition and deadly revenge from rivals while fighting for their hard-won love.

title: They Called Me a Homewrecker—Now They Live to Regret It
original_title: They Called Me a Homewrecker—Now They Live to Regret It
synopsis: On the eve of her wedding, a humiliation disguised as a "joke" exposes a secret her fiancé and best friend have kept for years. Serena doesn't fight back—she leaves the country with an urn. Three years later, she returns as a top executive at Cavell Group and makes everyone pay at a charity gala. But when the truth goes live, she realizes: some debts can be settled, but some people can never come back.

title: Fake Boyfriend
synopsis: A powerful CEO, mistaken for a waiter at his girlfriend's family gathering, faces ridicule from her relatives. But by the end of the night, he earns their respect and wins her love.

title: Sasural Murder Ka
synopsis: A short-form Hindi series whose story centres on a murder connected to the in-laws' household.

title: Villa Paradise
synopsis: A group of young people arrives with luggage at a beachside villa introduced as Paradise.

title: Cursed Daughter
synopsis: A young woman seeks the truth behind a diary, at the heart of a story about a daughter living under a curse.

title: Supreme Wealth
synopsis: A wealth-and-power story that opens with a character named Kunal being urged to run.

title: Corporate Dulhan
synopsis: Jab shaadi mandap nahi, negotiation table ban jaaye… Tab pyaar bikta hai, power bolti hai aur sach blast hota hai!

title: Arabpati Ka Secret
synopsis: Dubai se wapas aaya tha pyaar ke liye… par mila dhoka aur ek nayi kahani ka twist. Kya Reena ke dil mein ab bhi jagah hai Kabir ke liye?

title: Dilwala Vs Daulatwala
synopsis: Ek jhoothi love story, ek asli connection. Jab nakli gareeb boyfriend nikla billionaire, toh hui ek sunder kahani ki shuruaat!

title: Shaadi: A Perfect Cover
synopsis: Usne dushman ke ghar mein ghus kar badla lena tha… par dil uske dushman ki beti ko de baitha. Jab pyaar aur badla ek hi taraf ho, toh khel aur khatarnak ho jaata hai.

title: Crorepati Safaiwala
synopsis: Kursi chhodi, par zameer nahi. Ek aadmi jo har jhoot ke beech sach ban kar khada raha. Yeh kahani hai izzat, insaaniyat aur ek nayi shuruaat ki.
